concerns.text: FR-003 requires conformer ensembles of size ≥ 50 per molecule, but the verification step for T009 only checks for ≥ 30 conformers after energy filtering, weakening the functional requirement.
SC-005 (total runtime ≤ 6 h on CPU‑only runner) has no associated task that measures or enforces this runtime budget, making the success criterion untestable.
SC-002 demands a reported conformer‑generation success‑rate against a threshold, yet no task produces a quantitative success‑rate metric—only a molecule count is asserted.

Constitution FR-030 (Reproducibility) requires deterministic random seeds and checksummed artifacts; the tasks neither pin seeds nor guarantee creation of the `state/pending/checksums.yaml` file, violating reproducibility and data‑hygiene principles.

Constitution FR-030 (Data Hygiene) mandates that every file under `data/` be checksummed and recorded; the checksum utility described in T003 is incomplete and the required `checksums.yaml` is never created, breaching the constitution.

The implementation plan introduces a conditional scaling‑law model (if linear R² < 0.3) which is not mentioned in the specification, constituting scope creep and a drift from the defined functional requirements.
